As a member of AACSB, the world’s leading business education alliance, IU collaborates globally to enhance the quality of business education and continuously improve teaching and research.

network.stated_total_quote: Right now, the IU International University of Applied Sciences Agent Network is thriving with over 400+ passionate Agents dedicated to making education accessible worldwide! Leading the charge, most of our Agents hail from India, followed by Pakistan, and then the United Arab Emirates. Our agents assist with visa support, application processes, accommodation, airport assistance, study abroad loans, and preparation for the English Proficiency Test (EPT), providing support before and after arrival
